verdict_per_band.near-UV: OPACITY-DOMINATED — -0.1721 excess over the control, robust across the sigma sweep, in a band whose catalogued opacity is already complete to the VALD threshold. The deficit is real and is NOT catalogueable from what we hold.
verdict_per_band.VIS: CONTROL — side-bands line-free by selection; sets the floor
verdict_per_band.red-optical: OPACITY — and specifically UNCORRECTED telluric, not residual-after-molecfit. The 7 windows the correction never touched are MORE depressed (-0.0382) than the 3 it acted on (-0.0237). A per-band continuum redo here would divide by real absorption.
verdict_per_band.NIR-H: UNDETERMINED — the deficit is not separable from the line-width assumption: -0.0573 at the physical sigma but +0.0990 at sigma x2, where it CHANGES SIGN and the catalogue over-predicts absorption. Classifying it either way would be reading the sigma, not the data.

part_A_payoff_estimate.reading: UPPER BOUND on both factors. Even crediting the weak-line haze with its maximum and crediting a full deblend with RYA-1189's whole -0.086 dex, a completeness build closes ~0.028 dex of a 0.13-0.19 dex gap. ⚠️ The -0.086 is itself a lower bound in magnitude (the near-UV lines are saturated), so this estimate is not tight in either direction and is offered as an ORDER, not a number to plan on.

kind: DIAGNOSTIC — nothing added to any list, no published value changed

method.what: catalogued-opacity accounting, NOT a synthesis differential
method.why: Turbospectrum's bsyn_lu is absent from this Mac and MOOG is a Linux ELF; `spectrum` is arm64 but is not the production engine (RYA-289). A true synthesis differential is owed as a Sirius run.
method.sigma_basis: quadrature of a 1.6 km/s Doppler width and the INSTRUMENTAL width from instrument_catalog.csv's declared resolving power (geometric mean of min/max); swept x0.6 and x2.0
